facts.text: The user asked where additional image links are in SQL for PrestaShop.
The user wanted an SQL query to select all images for all product_id and additional images.
The user wanted the main image in a column named "main_image" and additional gallery images in other columns with each picture in a single column.
The user reported that the images column values are NULL.
The user wanted to select all id_product with id_lang 7 from ps_product_lang.
The user wanted a query that outputs different columns including id_products, description, description_short, link_rewrite, meta_description, meta_title, and name.
The user asked to create a SQL query that exports all information for each product in a single column.
The user wanted the export to include product images, attributes and options of the product, and categories.

keyphrases: export all product information single column
